P2-A coverage samples

p2a_events.json is the only authoritative historical event sample for MR-COVERAGE-P2-A.

- expected_treatment is an editorial label, not a production ranking or forced-publish rule.
- historical_observation describes displayed coverage on the named brief date.
- Uncovered display is not automatically an engineering fault.
- Missing files stay null. Do not invent raw IDs.
- Times keep their precision; a date-only value is not UTC midnight.
- Workspace archive_ref is 94bc895 plus local data files.
